item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】PACK - Rihanna - 2 rare ChRIHstmas Songs
item.description:
Hello, everyone!
After years looking for FLAC files of these Rihanna's christmas songs, i finally found it!

The songs are "It Just Don't Feel Like Xmas (Without You)" and "A Child Is Born", released on christmas collections "NOW! That's What I Call Christmas" Volumes 3 and 4.
They are kinda rare to find, so I hope you guys enjoy it <3

Merry ChRIHstmas y'all!
